issues.description: Docstring format 'Conan recipe for microjson — a tiny JSON parser in C using fixed-extent storage.' does not follow the suggested format 'Conan recipe — {name} {version} ({build_system})' from code style rule 1.

Hardcoded OHOS-specific fallback paths for ar ('/data/service/hnp/bin/llvm-ar') and ranlib ('/data/service/hnp/bin/llvm-ranlib') will fail on non-OHOS platforms. While using self.conf.get() is correct per R33, the fallback values reduce portability.
issues.fix_suggestion: Use more portable fallbacks such as 'llvm-ar' and 'llvm-ranlib' (relying on PATH), or document that these fallbacks assume OHOS environment.

summary: Re-audit of microjson 1.6 Conan recipe PR (feat/microjson-1.6) after fixes. Verdict: PASS. All previously identified P1 and P2 issues have been resolved: (1) P1 template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' replaced with actual URL 'https://gitcode.com/OpenHarmonyPCDeveloper/build_in_harmonyos'; (2) P2 manual mirror URLs removed, only official GitHub URL remains in conandata.yml; (3) P2 patch_type changed from 'bugfix' to 'portability'; (4) P2 patch_description reformatted to '0001 fix example linking rules for OHOS build'; (5) P2 .build-closed state file removed from PR; (6) P2 manifest.yaml patches_applied name corrected to '0001-Makefile.patch' matching actual file. No P0 deception issues found: test_package/test.c calls real microjson API (json_read_object, json_error_string) with 5 value assertions (count==42, flag1==true, flag2==false, name=='hello'); test_package/conanfile.py runs cmake.test() properly (no skip/forge); sha256 '999a48262a4029e865f4ee358de8ba693df5b7e98f1f157c79ac55b82fc5f2d9' is valid 64-hex-char hash (not forged); status 'built' is consistent across all files (manifest.yaml x2, README.md, notes.md) and honestly indicates verified-but-not-uploaded. No P1 recipe correctness issues: version 1.6 matches upstream, Conan 2.x API used correctly (from conan import ConanFile), no template placeholders (TODO/FIXME/XXX), official GitHub source URL (https://github.com/Otteri/microjson/archive/refs/tags/1.6.tar.gz), self.conf.get() for compiler (R33 compliant), method order correct (export_sources→requirements→layout→source→build→package→package_info). 2 P3 suggestions remain for docstring format and hardcoded OHOS fallback paths (non-blocking). File structure is complete: conanfile.py, conandata.yml, test_package/ (CMakeLists.txt, MANIFEST.yml, conanfile.py, test.c), patches/0001-Makefile.patch, manifest.yaml, notes.md, README.md all present. All 12 changed files are under archives/m/microjson/ — no framework file boundary violations. PR is atomic (single recipe only).
